ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark/black) pixels across >90% of the surface area with isolated high-intensity (white) clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity base with discrete high-contrast white annular clusters (rosettes) scattered semi-randomly across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the medial center; approximately 80-degree interior angle with a well-defined vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations and minor notches along the entire linear edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex sweep tapering from the central notch to narrow distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular white rings and clusters ranging from 10-30 pixels in diameter distributed across the ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent diagonal white linear mark (~50 pixels length) on the left lobe; multiple smaller, faint linear disruptions on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Orange and brown high-contrast clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced erosion/fragmentation at the extreme tips of the flukes where biological matter is attached.
